pattern: Post-Pump Falling Wedge / Complex Continuation Case
initial_hypothesis: Expected a pierce/retest of the rising support followed by continuation upward toward the falling-wedge potential target.
observed_progress: local rising support was later broken downward
price nevertheless recovered and continued grinding upward
original bullish directional scenario may still realize despite invalidation of the local entry structure
a larger possible rising wedge / opposing parent structure begins to appear
post_pump_risk_hypothesis: A bullish falling wedge near the highs after a strong pump may carry elevated distribution/dump risk and should not be ranked like the same geometry near a broader support/base.
pump_dump_base_hypothesis: If a powerful dump develops after a pump, search for evidence that the dangerous decline is ending near the base/foot of the pump-and-dump structure. A falling wedge forming there is a candidate reversal context, but must still require defined confirmation and stop/invalidation logic rather than automatic entry.
outcome_policy: Save the final resolution later without rewriting the original hypothesis.
